description: Find pay-per-call x402 APIs for a task across the whole Coinbase Bazaar: up to 20 listings with name, URL, method, price in USD, networks, 30-day payers and calls, and when each was last paid for, in the Bazaar's relevance order or sorted by use or price, with a price cap and an active-only filter. Our own listings are marked, never boosted. Use when an agent needs a paid tool it does not have yet. Example: q=email verification. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
